messages.subject: add custom text to facet-plot
parts:
Hi,

I have created a facet plot with additional hlines (n=3).
Now I'd like to add some text (labels ) to the lines manually.
Thus I tried to use: annotate("text", x = 0.00000001, y = 100, label =
"Some text")
which creates text, but the text is on each facet, but I only want
it on one of them... What is the correct way to add custom text
only once in a facet grid?
And how can I set the size of the annotation text to a similar size
like the axis titles but in grey color?

best regards,
Johannes

messages.author: deb55ea526b6a46e
messages.subject: RE: add custom text to facet-plot
parts:
You have to make a data frame to pass to geom_text with that particular facet variables.  Here's an example I stole somewhere to illustrate:

library(ggplot2) 
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) + geom_point() 
p <- p + facet_grid(. ~ cyl) 
#create a new data frame with the info 
ann_text <- data.frame(mpg = 15,wt = 5,lab = "Text", 
                       cyl = factor(8,levels = c(4, 6, 8))) 
p + geom_text(data = ann_text,label = "Text") 



Cheers,
Tyler
